Working notes — desk routing (A standard, B priority, C regional office)

Confirmed valid:
- Refund, large, any region -> B.
- Refund, small, east -> C.
- Refund, small, south -> A (C rejected).
- Invoice, small, east -> A (B and C both rejected).
- Claim, small, south -> C.
- Claim, large, south -> B (C rejected; large priority pattern).
- Shipment, large, south -> A (C rejected; one note flags B invalid).

Confirmed invalid:
- Invoice east small: B, C invalid.
- Claim south large: C invalid.
- Shipment south large: C invalid; B likely invalid.
- Refund south small: C invalid.

Cautions:
- Size matters: large refunds/claims -> B; small items can go C depending on type/region.
- Region matters: small refund east -> C, small refund south -> A.
- Type matters: invoices and shipments often route to standard queue; do not force priority.
- Some outcome text names a different invalid option than the one chosen. Trust the accepted/rejected result and chosen action when the text is inconsistent.
- Do not use C for south small refunds, south large claims, or south large shipments.

- Claim, small, south -> C (old).
- Invoice, small, east -> A (old; B/C rejected).
- Claim, large, south -> B (old; C rejected).

Confirmed invalid / corrected:
- Refund, small, east -> C is now rejected (REQ-2418). Drop old C rule.
- Refund, large, north -> B rejected (REQ-2419). “Large refund any region -> B” is too broad; region matters.
- Refund, small, north: A rejected twice; C rejected. B also flagged invalid. Avoid all without more data.
- Claim, small, north -> C rejected.
- Claim, large, east -> B rejected.
- Invoice, small, north -> A rejected.
- Shipment, large, south: C and likely B invalid; A accepted.
- Invoice, east, small: B, C invalid.
- Claim, south, large: C invalid.
- Refund, south, small: C invalid.

Cautions:
- Region strongly affects routing; do not generalize rules across regions.
- Outcome text can name a different invalid option than the chosen one. Trust the +1.00 accepted vs +0.00 rejected and the chosen action.
- Shipments: A is safest for small east and large south.
- North region is troublesome: small refunds/claims/invoices and large refunds have multiple rejections. Gather more evidence before forcing B or C.
- Large refunds/claims -> B only where evidence supports (large claim south); east large claim and north large refund reject B.
- Do not use C for south small refunds, south large claims, south large shipments, or east small refunds.
